name: gds-itemization-v2
description: V2 preview specialist plugin for equipment and itemization design. It isolates one specialist runtime from the broader Game Design Suite so ChatGPT can select a focused professional workflow directly.

interface.shortDescription: Focused equipment, affix, enhancement, loot, replacement and salvage design
interface.longDescription: A single-specialist V2 preview for equipment and itemization. It covers slot architecture, rarity, base/main/substats, affix pools and rolls, enhancement, set and unique effects, acquisition funnels, replacement cadence, graduation, salvage, duplicate value, and build-ecology risks.
defaultPrompt: Design a complete RPG itemization system from slots through affixes, enhancement, loot targeting, replacement and salvage.
Audit this equipment system for dead affixes, upgrade probability, sunk-cost replacement friction and BiS lock.
Design the stat budget and random-roll model for this gear system.
